rows.note_on_source_recency: FSSAI CTR IX Feb 2026 searchable metadata; exact table passage and Gazette must be inspected
rows.explicit_analytical_guard: TWO DIFFERENT FSSAI-HOSTED 2024 manuals assign code 09.001 to distinct methods (AAS versus ICP-OES). Require complete manual title/PDF, method principle, current adoption/supersession authority, named analyte/matrix, laboratory scope and measured LOQ BEFORE testing or PASS. Published ICP-OES 09.001 has Pb LOQ 6 mg/kg; it cannot substantiate even the 2.5 mg/kg generic food-lead candidate without a separately validated, sufficiently sensitive method. The other AAS 09.001 states Pb approximate capability 0.4 mg/kg and excludes foods with fat ≥40% and milk powder. Dispensed-water legal classification and sample are unique: use appropriate water method and calibrated LOQ, not generic food ICP-OES. The 26 June 2024 FSSAI notice listed manual B for stakeholder comments (scientific-panel recommended); no final adoption or supersession document established. Do not treat a proposed code as the applicable statutory lab method.
rows.published_FSSR_specific_identity_finding: Vended purified drinking water is expressly distinct from packaged drinking water or mineral water; IS:10500 is referenced.

rows.ICPMS_Pb_matrix_and_reporting_caveat: Dry-matter capability is a published scope, not demonstrated lot LOQ. Validate wet/dry/reconstitution, fat digestion, contamination controls and current Authority adoption. A signed legal threshold and lab accredited method are still mandatory.
